pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Assajipunabbasukā nāma Kiṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā honti alajjino pāpabhikkhū.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.4: mālāvacchaṃ ropenti pi ropāpenti pi siñcanti pi siñcāpenti pi ocinanti pi ocināpenti pi ganthenti pi ganthāpenti pi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.5: ekatovaṇṭikamālaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi ubhatovaṇṭikamālaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.6: mañjarikaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi vidhutikaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi vaṭaṃsakaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi āveḷaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi uracchadaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.7: te kulitthīnaṃ kuladhītānaṃ kulakumārīnaṃ kulasuṇhānaṃ kuladāsīnaṃ ekatovaṇṭikamālaṃ haranti pi harāpenti pi ubhatovaṇṭikamālaṃ haranti pi harāpenti pi mañjarikaṃ haranti pi harāpenti pi vidhutikaṃ haranti pi harāpenti pi vaṭaṃsakaṃ haranti pi harāpenti pi āveḷaṃ haranti pi harāpenti pi uracchadaṃ haranti pi harāpenti pi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.8: te kulitthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājane pi bhuñjanti ekathālake pi pivanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.9: ekāsane pi nisīdanti ekamañce pi tuvaṭṭenti ekattharaṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti ekapāvuraṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti ekattharaṇapāvuraṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.10: vikāle pi bhuñjanti majjam pi pivanti mālāgandhavilepanam pi dhārenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.11: naccanti pi gāyanti pi vādenti pi lāsenti pi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.12: naccantiyāpi naccanti naccantiyāpi gāyanti naccantiyāpi vādenti naccantiyāpi lāsenti gāyantiyāpi naccanti . . . vādentiyāpi naccanti . . . lāsentiyāpi naccanti . . . lāsentiyāpi lāsenti ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.2.1: aṭṭhapade pi kīḷanti dasapade pi kīḷanti ākāse pi kīḷanti parihārapathe pi kīḷanti santikāya pi kīḷanti khalikāya pi kīḷanti ghaṭikena pi kīḷanti salākahatthena pi kīḷanti akkhena pi kīḷanti paṅgacīrena pi kīḷanti vaṅkakena pi kīḷanti mokkhacikāya pi kīḷanti ciṅgulakena pi kīḷanti pattāḷhakena pi kīḷanti rathakena pi kīḷanti dhanukena pi kīḷanti akkharikāya pi kīḷanti manesikāya pi kīḷanti yathāvajjena pi kīḷanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.2.2: hatthismim pi sikkhanti assasmim pi sikkhanti rathasmim pi sikkhanti dhanusmim pi sikkhanti tharusmim pi sikkhanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.2.3: hatthissa pi purato dhāvanti assassa pi purato dhāvanti rathassa pi purato dhāvanti dhāvanti pi ādhāvanti pi usseḷhenti pi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.2.4: appoṭhenti pi nibbujjhanti pi muṭṭhīhi pi yujjhanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.2.5: raṅgamajjhe pi saṃghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti idha bhagini naccassū 'ti nalāṭikam pi denti vividham pi anācāraṃ ācaranti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Kāsīsu vassaṃ vuttho Sāvatthiṃ gacchanto bhagavantaṃ dassanāya yena Kiṭāgiri tad avasari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.2: atha kho so bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Kiṭāgiriṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.3: pāsādikena abhikkantena paṭikkantena ālokitena vilokitena sammiñjitena pasāritena okkhittacakkhu iriyāpathasampanno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.4: manussā taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā evaṃ āhaṃsu: kv āyaṃ abalabalo viya mandamando viya bhākuṭikabhākuṭiko viya, ko imassa upagatassa piṇḍakam pi dassati. amhākaṃ pana ayyā Assajipunabbasukā saṇhā sakhilā sukhasambhāsā mihitapubbaṃgamā ehisvāgatavādino abbhākuṭikā uttānamukhā pubbabhāsino, tesaṃ kho nāma piṇḍo dātabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.5: addasa kho aññataro upāsako taṃ bhikkhuṃ Kiṭāgirismiṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.6: disvāna yena so bhikkhu ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā etad avoca: api bhante piṇḍo labbhatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.1: atha kho so upāsako taṃ bhikkhuṃ gharaṃ netvā bhojetvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.3: Sāvatthiṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso gamissāmi bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.4: tena hi bhante mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda evañ ca vadehi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.6: Assajipunabbasukā nāma Kiṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā alajjino pāpabhikkhū,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.9: ye pi te bhante manussā pubbe saddhā ahesuṃ pasannā te pi etarahi assaddhā appasannā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.10: yāni pi tāni saṃghassa pubbe dānapathāni tāni pi etarahi upacchinnāni,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.12: sādhu bhante bhagavā Kiṭāgiriṃ bhikkhū pahiṇeyya yathāyaṃ Kiṭāgirismiṃ āvāso saṇṭhaheyyā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.1: evaṃ āvuso 'ti kho so bhikkhu tassa upāsakassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Sāvatthi tena pakkāmi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.2: anupubbena yena Sāvatthi Jetavanaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.3: āciṇṇaṃ kho pan' etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.4: atha kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.10: idhāhaṃ bhante Kāsīsu vassaṃ vuttho Sāvatthiṃ āgacchanto bhagavantaṃ dassanāya yena Kiṭāgiri tad avasariṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.11: atha khv' āhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Kiṭāgiriṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.12: addasa kho maṃ bhante aññataro upāsako Kiṭāgirismiṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.13: disvāna yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā etad avoca: api bhante piṇḍo labbhatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.16: atha kho bhante so upāsako maṃ gharaṃ netvā bhojetvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.18: Sāvatthiṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso gamissāmi bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.2: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Assajipunabbasukā nāma Kiṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā alajjino pāpabhikkhū, te evarūpaṃ anācāraṃ ācaranti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.3: mālāvacchaṃ ropenti pi --la-- vividham pi anācāraṃ ācaranti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.9: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā evarūpaṃ anācāraṃ ācarissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.10: mālāvacchaṃ ropessanti pi ropāpessanti pi siñcissanti pi siñcāpessanti pi ocinissanti pi ocināpessanti pi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.12: ganthessanti pi ganthāpessanti pi . . . karissanti pi kārāpessanti pi . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.17: naccissanti pi gāyissanti pi vādissanti pi lāsessanti pi . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.21: appoṭhissanti pi nibbujjhissanti pi muṭṭhīhi pi yujjhissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.22: raṅgamajjhe pi saṃghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vakkhanti idha bhagini naccassū 'ti, nalāṭikam pi dassanti vividham pi anācāraṃ ācarissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.24: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā Sāriputtamoggallāne āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.25: gacchatha tumhe Sāriputtā Kiṭāgiriṃ gantvā Assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ Kiṭāgirismā pabbājaniyakammaṃ karotha, tumhākaṃ ete saddhivihārino 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.26: kathaṃ mayaṃ bhante Assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ Kiṭāgirismā pabbājaniyakammaṃ karoma, caṇḍā te bhikkhū pharusā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.27: tena hi tumhe Sāriputtā bahukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ gacchathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.28: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho Sāriputtamoggallānā bhagavato paccassosuṃ. ||6||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.4: āpattiṃ ropetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.6: ime Assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū kuladūsakā pāpasamācārā, imesaṃ pāpakā samācārā dissanti c' eva suyyanti ca kulāni ca imehi duṭṭhāni dissanti c' eva suyyanti ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.7: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho Assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ Kiṭāgirismā pabbājaniyakammaṃ kareyya na Assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi Kiṭāgirismiṃ vatthabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.11: Assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ Kiṭāgirismā pabbājaniyakammaṃ karoti na Assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi Kiṭāgirismiṃ vatthabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.12: yassāyasmato khamati Assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ Kiṭāgirismā pabbājaniyassa kammassa karaṇaṃ na Assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi Kiṭāgirismiṃ vatthabban ti so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.15: tatiyam pi etam atthaṃ vadāmi: suṇātu me . . . so bhāseyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.16: kataṃ saṃghena Assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ Kiṭāgirismā pabbājaniyakammaṃ na Assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi Kiṭāgirismiṃ vatthabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.17: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||7||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.1: atha kho Sāriputtamoggallānapamukho bhikkhusaṃgho Kiṭāgiriṃ gantvā Assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ Kiṭāgirismā pabbājaniyakammaṃ akāsi na Assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi Kiṭāgirismiṃ vatthabban ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.2: te saṃghena pabbājaniyakammakatā na sammāvattanti na lomaṃ pātenti na netthāraṃ vattanti bhikkhū na khamāpenti akkosanti paribhāsanti chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpenti pakkamanti pi vibbhamanti pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.4: kathaṃ hi nāma Assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū saṃghena pabbājaniyakammakatā na sammāvattissanti na lomaṃ pātessanti na netthāraṃ vattissanti bhikkhū na khamāpessanti akkosissanti paribhāsissanti chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpessanti pakkamissanti pi vibbhamissanti pīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.6: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū saṃghena pabbājaniyakammakatā na sammāvattanti --pa-- vibbhamanti pīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.9: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.10.1: bhikkhu pan' eva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, tassa kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti c' eva suyyanti ca kulāni ca tena duṭṭhāni dissanti c' eva suyyanti ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.11: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.12: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti c' eva suyyanti ca kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti c' eva suyyanti ca. pakkamat' āyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alan te idhavāsenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.13: evañ ca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.14: chandagāmino ca bhikkhū dosagāmino ca bhikkhū mohagāmino ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū, tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti ekaccaṃ na pabbājentīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.15: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.16: māyasmā evaṃ avaca, na ca bhikkhū chandagāmino na ca bhikkhū dosagāmino na ca bhikkhū mohagāmino na ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.17: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti c' eva suyyanti ca kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti c' eva suyyanti ca. pakkamat' āyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alan te idhavāsenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.18: evañ ca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath' eva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.19: yāvatatiyaṃ ce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.1: bhikkhu pan' eva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ va nigamaṃ vā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.2: gāmo pi nigamo pi nagaraṃ pi gāmo c' eva nigamo ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.6: cattāri kulāni khattiyakulaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ vessakulaṃ suddakulaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.8: kulāni dūseti pupphena vā phalena vā cuṇṇena vā mattikāya vā dantakaṭṭhena vā veḷuyā vā vejjikāya vā jaṅghapesanikena vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.10: mālāvacchaṃ ropeti pi ropāpeti pi siñcati pi siñcāpeti pi ocināti pi ocināpeti pi gantheti pi ganthāpeti pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.12: ye sammukhā te passanti ye tirokkhā te suṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.14: pubbe saddhā hutvā taṃ āgamma assaddhā honti, pasannā hutvā appasannā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.16: ye sammukhā te passanti ye tirokkhā te suṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.20: aññehi bhikkhūhi ye passanti ye suṇanti, tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.21: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho . . . idhavāsenā 'ti. evañ ca
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.22: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyya . . . na pabbājentīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.26: aññehi bhikkhūhi ye passanti ye suṇanti, tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.34: so bhikkhu saṃghamajjham pi ākaḍḍhitvā vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.45: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu saṃghena pabbājaniyakammakato bhikkhū chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.47: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.63: saṃgho 'va tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ deti mūlāya paṭikassati mānattaṃ deti abbheti, na sambahulā na ekapuggalo, tena vuccati saṃghādiseso 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.64: tass' eva āpattinikāyassa nāma kammaṃ adhivacanaṃ, tena pi vuccati saṃghādiseso 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.1.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṃghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.7: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto terasa saṃghādisesā dhammā, nava paṭhamāpattikā cattāro yāvatatiyakā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.8: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvatihaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti tāvatihaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.9: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttariṃ chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.10: ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṃgho tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.11: ekena pi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṃgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito te ca bhikkhū gārayhā. ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.15: parisuddh' etthāyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti.
